userStoryObject.title: As a DevOps Manager, I want a dashboard showing real-time incident status and response progress so that I can monitor system health and response effectiveness
userStoryObject.description:
CONTEXT & BACKGROUND:

Visibility into incidents and responses is critical for managing system reliability.

CURRENT STATE:

Incident status is tracked manually or via disparate tools.

DESIRED STATE:

A centralized dashboard displays real-time incident detection, response actions, and resolution status.

KEY FUNCTIONALITY:

  • Real-time incident status updates
  • Visualization of response actions and progress
  • Historical incident data and metrics
  • Filtering and search capabilities
  • Role
-based access control

USER INTERACTION FLOW:

  1. Manager logs into dashboard
  2. Dashboard shows current active incidents
  3. Manager selects an incident to view details
  4. Dashboard displays response actions and progress
  5. Manager reviews historical incident trends
  6. Manager exports reports if needed


TECHNICAL CONSIDERATIONS:

Integration with incident detection and response systems, real-time data streaming, secure access controls, responsive UI design, data storage for history

OUT OF SCOPE:

Incident response initiation or modification via dashboard

SUCCESS METRICS:

95% uptime of dashboard, 80% positive user feedback on usability, reduced time to incident status awareness

Persona: System User (System User)
userStoryObject.acceptanceCriteria:
Criteria 1: Dashboard displays real-time incident status updates
